questions.question_text: Which data structure operates on a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) basis?
questions.explanation: A stack follows the LIFO principle where the last element added is the first one removed.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered 'volatile' memory?
questions.explanation: RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile because it requires power to maintain the stored information.

questions.question_text: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing and logical addressing?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer manages logical addressing (IP addresses) and routing of data packets.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a non-relational database management system?
questions.explanation: MongoDB is a NoSQL database, while the others are relational databases (RDBMS).

questions.question_text: In object-oriented programming, what does 'encapsulation' refer to?
options: Creating many instances of a class
Hiding internal data and requiring interaction via methods
A class inheriting from another class
The ability to run functions in parallel
questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data and the methods that operate on that data, restricting direct access to some of an object's components.

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of an operating system's kernel?
options: Managing hardware resources and CPU scheduling
questions.explanation: The kernel is the core of the OS that bridges applications and hardware.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a binary search complexity in the worst-case scenario?
questions.explanation: Binary search consistently halves the search area, resulting in logarithmic time complexity.

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of the HTML 'alt' attribute?
options: To provide text for search engines
To provide alternative text for images
To link to a new webpage
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute displays text if an image fails to load or for screen readers.

questions.question_text: Which HTTP status code indicates 'Not Found'?
questions.explanation: 404 is the standard HTTP error code for a resource that cannot be located.

questions.question_text: What is a 'deadlock' in operating systems?
options: When two or more processes are waiting indefinitely for each other to release resources
When a computer crashes during boot
questions.explanation: A deadlock occurs when processes are stuck waiting for resources held by others in a circular chain.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a common version control system?
questions.explanation: Git is the industry-standard distributed version control system.

questions.question_text: What is the result of 1010 AND 1100 in binary?
questions.explanation: The AND operator returns 1 only if both bits are 1. 1010 & 1100 = 1000.
